name: features-section-demo-2
title: Icon Feature Grid
blurb: 4-column feature grid with icon, title, and description per card.
description: Eight feature cards with leading icons (from tabler-icons), bold titles, and descriptive text. Responsive 1-to-4 column layout.
use_when: Product feature showcases or service listings where icon + text hierarchy quickly communicates benefits.
avoid_when: Minimal-text designs where card density or icon variety may create visual noise.
a11y: Icons are paired with descriptive text; no icon-only cards. Card hierarchy is semantic.
